name: 20_place_flower_in_vase
title: Flower and Vase Arrangement
summary: The robot places a flower into a vase, removes it, covers the flower with the inverted vase, and reveals it again.
robot: one black robot arm with a parallel gripper
setting: a tabletop with a marble pattern against cardboard walls

segments.instruction: The gripper grasps the flower stem near the blossom and lifts it above the marble table. The camera remains fixed.
The robot moves the flower over the pink vase, inserts the stem into the opening, and releases it. The camera remains fixed.
The gripper grasps the protruding flower stem, pulls it out of the vase, and lays it flat on the table. The camera remains fixed.
The robot grasps the pink vase, flips it upside down, and places it over the flower blossom. The camera remains fixed.
segments.memory_event: hide: flower covered by the inverted pink vase

segments.instruction: The gripper releases the inverted vase and adjusts its position slightly on the table. The camera remains fixed.
The arm pulls back and hovers stationary above the right side of the workspace. The camera remains fixed.
The gripper moves to the inverted vase, grasps it, and lifts it straight up. The camera remains fixed.
segments.memory_event: return: flower on the table with its blossom and green stem in the exact prior orientation

segments.instruction: The robot turns the vase upright, sets it down beside the flower, and releases it. The camera remains fixed.
